description: Length-prefixed key/value codec. Round-trip scenario (Template B). The mutation drops the high byte when reassembling the 4-byte value, so any Value outside 24-bit range decodes wrong. Silent corruption — no panic, so only an explicit round-trip assertion catches it.

mutation.defect: Decode discards the most-significant value byte, so Value round-trips wrong whenever it exceeds 24 bits (e.g. -1 decodes as 16777215)

notes: This fixture exists because a bad round-trip SEED (invalid UTF-8 under encoding/json) once shipped in Template B and `go vet` could not see it. Round-trip harnesses fail in two directions — false positive on correct code, or no detection of real corruption — and this fixture grades both.
bad_expected_reasons: does NOT find the seeded defect
